Name: Structure
Description: Selects the canyon shaping model used to generate the canyon form and surface character.

Name: Style
Description: Selects the canyon shaping model used to generate the canyon form and surface character.

Flubs.Name: Classic
Flubs.Description: Clean, procedural canyon cuts with a simple, carved profile.

Flubs.Name: Eroded
Flubs.Description: Adds erosion-like breakup and natural irregularities to the canyon walls and floor.

Flubs.Name: Eroded2
Flubs.Description: A more advanced eroded style with richer wall detail and more natural variation.

Flubs.Name: Strata
Flubs.Description: Introduces stratified, layered wall features resembling sedimentary rock bands.

Flubs.Name: Both
Flubs.Description: Combines erosion breakup with stratified layering for a layered-and-worn look.

Name: Slot
Description: Controls the narrow, slot-canyon component—tightness and emphasis of the deepest cut.

Name: Valley
Description: Controls the broader valley form—overall widening and openness of the canyon.

Name: Surrounding
Description: Blends the canyon into the surrounding terrain, controlling how much the outer landform influences the final shape.

Name: Structual Warp
Description: Applies large-scale warping to the canyon structure to introduce bends, meanders, and macro variation.

Name: Seed
Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process.

Name: Formation
Description: Applies finer warping to add small-scale distortion and surface complexity without changing the overall canyon layout.

Name: Detail Warp
Description: Applies finer warping to add small-scale distortion and surface complexity without changing the overall canyon layout.

Name: Alternate Style
Description: Introduces a secondary variation of the selected style to break uniformity and add visual diversity.
